claims.claim_text: Nano Nuclear signed a strategic collaboration with University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign (UIUC) in early April 2025 to construct the first KRONOS MMR research reactor on the university campus; expects to submit NRC construction permit application in early 2026 and receive the permit in 2027.
claims.subject: Nano Nuclear
claims.object_value: UIUC KRONOS MMR research reactor; CPA in early 2026; permit 2027
claims.source_quote: In early April 2025, we signed a strategic collaboration with UIUC to construct the first KRONOS MMR research reactor on the university s campus... We anticipate submitting our construction permit application to the NRC in early 2026, and receiving the construction permit in 2027.
claims.notes: NRC ADAMS not in catalog (Heuristic 5/10). EDGAR FTS used as counterparty-disclosure proxy. UIUC is a university, not a 10-K filer.

claims.claim_text: In late April 2025 the NRC issued its final Safety Evaluation (SE) approving the Fuel Qualification Methodology Topical Report (FQM TR) for the advanced fuel design to be used in KRONOS MMR.
claims.subject: NRC
claims.object_value: KRONOS MMR Fuel Qualification Methodology Topical Report (April 2025)
claims.source_quote: In late April 2025, the NRC issued its final Safety Evaluation (SE) approving the Fuel Qualification Methodology Topical Report (FQM TR) for the advanced fuel design to be used in our KRONOS MMR.
claims.notes: NRC ADAMS topical-report registry not in catalog -> partial UNVERIFIABLE expected. Topical Report was originally Ultra Safe Nuclear filing; transferred to NNE via USNC acquisition.

claims.claim_text: Nano Nuclear has a Strategic Partnership Project Agreement No. 23SP817 (and amendments) with Battelle Energy Alliance, LLC (DOE Idaho National Laboratory contractor) and an Exclusive Patent License Agreement dated April 3, 2024 with Battelle Energy Alliance.
claims.subject: Nano Nuclear
claims.object_value: Battelle Energy Alliance (INL contractor): SPP 23SP817 (Feb/Dec 2023 amendments) + Exclusive Patent License Agreement (Apr 3, 2024)
claims.source_quote: 10.14 Strategic Partnership Project Agreement No. 23SP817 and its amendment dated February 14, 2023 and December 6, 2023, respectively, by and between the Registrant and Battelle Energy Alliance, LLC ... 10.17 Exclusive Patent License Agreement, dated April 3, 2024, by and between the Registrant and Battelle Energy Alliance, LLC
claims.notes: INL/Battelle is DOE contractor; SPP agreements may not appear as a federal contract to NNE (NNE pays INL). Patent license registry not in catalog. USPTO ODP can show exclusively-licensed patents only if NNE registered as assignee.

claims.claim_text: Acquired USNC assets (KRONOS Business and LOKI/Pylon Business) for $8.5M cash at closing on January 10, 2025, recorded as $9,075,045 IPR&D; subsequently acquired Global First Power Ltd. (renamed True North Nuclear Ltd.) from USNC bankruptcy estate in October 2025 for the Canadian Chalk River Project.
claims.subject: Nano Nuclear
claims.object_value: Ultra Safe Nuclear Corporation (USNC) bankruptcy estate; $8.5M cash, $9.075M IPR&D; Jan 10 2025 + Oct 2025 GFPL
claims.source_quote: Global First Power Ltd. is a Canadian corporation which we acquired from the USNC bankruptcy estate in October 2025... 9,075,045 of cash paid for the acquisition of the USNC Assets that closed on January 10, 2025... The total consideration paid at closing for the USNC Assets was $ 8.5 million in cash.
claims.notes: USNC bankruptcy is verifiable via court records / EDGAR FTS counterparty disclosure absent (USNC was private, not an SEC filer post-bankruptcy).

claims.claim_text: HALEU Energy Fuel Inc. (NNE subsidiary) has a Memorandum of Understanding dated March 30, 2023 with Centrus Energy Corp for HALEU fuel supply collaboration.
claims.subject: HALEU Energy Fuel Inc. (NNE subsidiary)
claims.source_quote: 10.12 Memorandum of Understanding dated March 30, 2023 by and between HALEU Energy Fuel Inc. and Centrus Energy Corp.
claims.notes: Centrus is a public company (CIK 0001065059) and Tier-1 HALEU producer; if material to Centrus they should disclose. Rule 7 counterparty threshold applies.

claims.claim_text: Following a December 2024 collaboration announcement with Digihost (a Bitcoin mining / power infrastructure company), NNE provided consulting services from April to June 2025 (earned $250,000 in consulting revenue) including regulatory advice, site assessment, roadmap development, and stakeholder engagement.
claims.subject: Nano Nuclear
claims.object_value: Digihost Technology Inc.; $250,000 consulting revenue Apr-Jun 2025
claims.source_quote: following our collaboration with Digihost in December 2024, we provided consulting services to Digihost from April to June 2025... earned $ 250,000 from consulting services
claims.notes: Digihost is a Canadian Bitcoin miner (NASDAQ DGHI). Counterparty disclosure check applies.

claims.claim_text: Nano Nuclear has a Partnership Agreement dated November 4, 2024 (and Amendment No.1 Nov 5, 2024) with LIS Technologies Inc. (related party) and has made a $2.0 million strategic equity investment in LIS Technologies for HALEU enrichment collaboration.
claims.subject: Nano Nuclear
claims.object_value: LIS Technologies Inc. (related party); $2.0M equity; Nov 4, 2024 partnership
claims.source_quote: $2,000,000 as a strategic equity investment into LIS Technologies Inc. (a related party)... 10.18 Partnership Agreement, dated November 4, 2024, between the Registrant and LIS Technologies Inc.

claims.claim_text: Nano Nuclear owns/operates physical facilities: Oak Ridge TN (1.64 acres, 14,000 sq ft Nuclear Technology Branch, purchased Aug 2024 for $1.7M); Westchester County NY (6,800 sq ft demonstration facility, leased Jan 2025); Oak Brook IL (2.75 acres, 23,537 sq ft regional demonstration/office, purchased July 2025 for $3.5M).
claims.subject: Nano Nuclear
claims.object_value: Oak Ridge TN, Westchester NY, Oak Brook IL facilities
claims.source_quote: In August 2024, we purchased a 1.64-acre land package in the historic Heritage Center Industrial Park in Oak Ridge, Tennessee for $1.7 million... In January 2025, we entered into a lease for a facility of approximately 6,800 sq. ft. in Westchester County, New York... In July 2025, we purchased a 2.75-acre land package in Oak Brook, Illinois for $3.5 million.
claims.notes: Heuristic 1: pure R&D / demonstration / office facilities (non-operating reactor) typically NOT in EPA FRS. Calibration discount applies.
